Role & responsibilities




Job Description AI/ML Engineer (LLM)
Role: AI/ML Engineer – Team Lead / Consultant
Primary Skill: Large Language Models (LLMs)
Location: Mumbai
Business Unit: Data & AI

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced AI/ML Engineer with strong expertise in Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, and AI application development. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying scalable, production-ready AI solutions using cloud-based AI services and on-premises infrastructure. The role involves implementing Generative AI models, developing chatbots, working with deep learning technologies, and ensuring high-quality AI pipelines.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and deploy AI-driven solutions using LLMs and Generative AI technologies.
Build and maintain scalable, production-ready AI applications and pipelines.
Integrate cloud AI services and on-premises infrastructure into AI solutions.
Lead the design and implementation of AI/ML solutions aligned with business requirements.
Develop and optimize LLM-powered applications, conversational agents, and chatbots.
Apply deep learning, neural networks, and image processing techniques where required.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve workflows, system performance, and solution quality.
Provide technical leadership, make key technical decisions, and resolve complex problems.
Mentor junior engineers and promote knowledge sharing and engineering best practices.
Ensure AI applications meet production standards for scalability, reliability, and performance.

Required Technical Skills

Strong hands-on experience with Large Language Models (LLMs).
Experience developing and deploying Generative AI applications.
Knowledge of cloud AI services and on-premises AI infrastructure.
Understanding of deep learning frameworks and neural network architectures.
Experience building and maintaining production-grade AI pipelines.
Knowledge of chatbot development and conversational AI.
Familiarity with image processing and AI/ML application development.
Strong problem-solving, technical leadership, and collaboration skills.

Preferred Skills

Experience with LLM application development and deployment.
Knowledge of prompt engineering, RAG, and AI application integration.
Experience with AI model evaluation, monitoring, and performance optimization.
Exposure to scalable AI architecture and production deployment practices.

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in LLMs and Generative AI, along with hands-on experience delivering production-ready AI solutions. The candidate must be capable of leading technical initiatives, coordinating with multiple teams, making architectural decisions, and mentoring junior team members.

Mandatory Skill: Large Language Models (LLMs).
